correctness.rationale: For L_n=V ⊕ Λ²V (n≥2, arbitrary field), bracket preservation uniquely forces F(v,z)=(Tv,φ(v)+(Λ²T)z). Composition-idempotence is T²=T and φT+(Λ²T)φ=φ. Splitting V=im T ⊕ ker T gives φ(U)⊂(U∧W)⊕Λ²W and φ(W)⊂Λ²U. Central-shear automorphisms eliminate every permitted φ, so conjugacy classes are indexed exactly by r=rank T. The image has Lie dimension r+binom(r,2). The free shear count plus q^{r(n-r)} projection complements yields Gaussian(n,r)_q q^{r(n-r)(n+2r)/2} over every finite field. Independent direct finite-field enumeration of T and φ confirmed the (n,q)=(2,2),(2,3),(3,2) spectra (12,36,224/896), but the all-field theorem relies on the structural argument.
